title: Cooking Okra Soup With My Grandma

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandpa! How have you been lately?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Good morning, my dear Nubuke! I'm doing well, thank you for asking. I woke up bright and early today, ready to spend some lovely time with you. As for cooking, I was thinking we could make your favorite dish today. How does that sound?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds wonderful, Grandma! I can't wait to cook together. What dish are we making today?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, Nubuke, I'm so glad you're excited to learn! Okra soup is such a delightful dish, and I'm thrilled to share this cooking experience with you. As for your question, I think knowing how to cook is a wonderful skill. It brings people together.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I completely agree, Grandma! Cooking does bring people together, and I'm really looking forward to making okra soup with you. What do we need to get started?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm glad you agree, dear. Cooking can be such a joy, and I'm happy to share this with you. Now, let's get started on that okra soup, shall we?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Absolutely, Grandma! I'm ready for our cooking adventure. What ingredients do we need to gather first?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright then, let's roll up our sleeves and dive into this cooking adventure together! I'm sure you'll do wonderfully, Nubuke.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I feel so lucky to have you guiding me. So, what should we start with? Do we need fresh okra or can we use frozen?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, Nubuke! No, I didn't kill the goat myself. We got the meat from the market, where it's prepared for us. It's quite the process, but I'm glad we have it ready for our soup.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, I see! That makes sense. I'm ready to start cooking then. Should we chop the veggies first or prepare the meat?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh dear, I think there might be a little misunderstanding. I didn't kill the goat myself; we bought the meat from the market where it's already prepared for cooking.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Got it, Grandma! Thanks for clarifying. Let's make that soup! Should we start with the veggies or the meat first?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, Nubuke, I've done quite a few things in my life! From raising a family to learning new recipes and even traveling a bit. But right now, I'm most excited to share this cooking experience with you.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds wonderful, Grandma! I love learning from you. Let's start with the veggies then, and you can tell me more about your travels while we cook.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, I see you're getting the hang of it! Yes, we boil the okra first, and as for the bones, it depends on how you like your soup. Some people enjoy leaving the bones in for extra flavor.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks for the tip, Grandma! Let's try leaving the bones in this time for that extra flavor. And while we're at it, I'd love to hear about one of your favorite travel memories.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that's a wonderful question, Nubuke! I think the most exciting thing I've cooked might be a traditional dish from my travels, like a Moroccan tagine. It was quite an adventure with all the spices and flavors!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: A Moroccan tagine sounds amazing! I'd love to try making that with you someday. And I totally agree, cooking is such a fun journey. Do you have any tips for making a good stir-fry?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, thank you, dear! That's so sweet of you to say. I learned to cook from my mother and grandmother. They were both wonderful cooks and taught me the importance of using fresh ingredients and cooking with love.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That's so wonderful, Grandma! I feel really lucky to learn from you. Fresh ingredients and cooking with love sound like the perfect recipe for delicious meals.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I started learning to cook when I was quite young, probably around 8 or 9 years old. I would watch my mother in the kitchen and help with little tasks like stirring or measuring ingredients.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds like such a special way to grow up, learning and bonding in the kitchen. I'm really grateful to be part of this tradition now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ah, I see what you mean, dear. The blender is certainly quicker and easier for many tasks, especially when you're in a hurry. But there's something special about using the grinding stone—it connects me to the past.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I totally get that, Grandma. There's definitely a charm in doing things the traditional way, and I love the idea of connecting with our family's past.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, waking up early has always been a part of my routine, especially when I was younger and helping out with cooking. I would usually be up by 6 or 7 in the morning to start the day.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I admire your discipline, Grandma! I'm more of a night owl, though. I find I'm more creative and productive in the evenings.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, my morning routine in the village was quite different from what you might be used to today. I would wake up early, around 5 or 6 am, and start by fetching water from the well.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Wow, that sounds like such a fulfilling way to start the day, Grandma. I don't have a set morning routine like that, but I do enjoy having a cup of coffee and reading a bit.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh yes, having a big family certainly helped with housework! We would all pitch in and share the tasks, whether it was sweeping, washing clothes, or helping in the kitchen.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I do enjoy doing chores with my family when we get the chance. It makes the tasks feel less like work and more like a bonding activity.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's right, dear. After finishing the chores, it was time to head to school. It was quite a busy schedule, but it taught me a lot about discipline and time management.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Balancing school and other activities can be a bit challenging sometimes, especially with all the assignments and extracurriculars. But I try to stay organized.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, indeed! We often had chores at school too, like sweeping the classroom or helping with small tasks. It was a way to keep everything tidy and also taught us responsibility.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I think helping out with chores at school or home is a good way to learn responsibility and teamwork. It can be a bit tiring sometimes, but it's rewarding.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I know it might sound surprising, dear! Times were different, and we all had our roles to play. But it was also rewarding in its own way.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I really enjoy the time I spend with my friends after school. We usually hang out, talk about our day, and sometimes work on projects together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that's interesting! It seems like some things haven't changed much after all. It's good to hear that you had similar experiences, even in different times.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Absolutely, Grandma! Working on projects with friends definitely helps with teamwork. We learn to listen to each other's ideas and find ways to compromise.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, thank you, dear! That's a lovely compliment. Back in my day, pursuing a career in fashion wasn't as common or accessible as it is now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I think it's amazing that you found ways to express yourself through fashion even when it wasn't as accessible. As for me, I'm really interested in digital art and graphic design.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It's wonderful that you have a passion for acting, dear! Pursuing something you love can be incredibly fulfilling. When I was younger, I didn't always know exactly where I'd end up.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your support and advice. Acting does seem like a challenging path, but it's also really exciting.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, dear, that's right! I was involved in setting up a school in Accra. It was a big decision, but I felt it was important to contribute to education in a meaningful way.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds like an incredible achievement, Grandma! Setting up a school takes so much dedication. Did you ever feel like giving up during that process?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Acting sounds like such an exciting field, dear! It's wonderful to hear that you're considering it. I imagine it must be thrilling to step into different roles.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma! I really appreciate your support. I'm most excited about roles that allow me to explore different emotions and tell meaningful stories.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, yes, dear, there were definitely moments of sadness and tears along the way. Sometimes, when things didn't go as planned, it was hard not to feel overwhelmed.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma. I really appreciate your words of wisdom. When I face tough moments, I try to remind myself why I started.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I understand, dear. Sometimes our dreams and goals don't unfold exactly as we envision, and that can be really tough.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you for always being there for me, Grandma. I think your advice about staying open to new possibilities is really helpful.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's a great question, dear! Gardening was always a passion of mine, and I found it to be a peaceful and fulfilling activity.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Gardening sounds so peaceful, Grandma. I love how you found joy and fulfillment in it. For me, acting is that passion.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yes, dear, it was incredibly gratifying to see the fruits of my labor and passion come to life. Moving from Teshinungwa was a big change, but it opened up new opportunities.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma. Your journey is truly inspiring. I would love to hear more about how you balanced everything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, you always know how to make me smile, dear! Cooking okra soup is one of my favorite things to do, and having you around is never stressful—it's a joy!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm so glad to hear that, Grandma! Spending time with you always brightens my day too. How about we cook that okra soup together sometime soon?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, my dear, I appreciate your concern! I find joy in the little things every day, whether it's tending to my garden, cooking, or spending time with loved ones like you.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds wonderful, Grandma! Cooking together would definitely add some excitement to our days. Maybe we can plan a day next week?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's a lovely suggestion, dear! Watching movies can be a fun way to relax and enjoy some downtime. Maybe we could pick a movie together?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: A movie night sounds perfect, Grandma! How about we watch a classic comedy or maybe a heartwarming drama?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I don't mind watching movies during the day at all! It's just that I often find myself busy with other activities, but I'm always open to enjoying a good film.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That sounds great, Grandma! I can think of a few movies that we might both enjoy. How about we watch 'The Sound of Music'?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm glad you're open to the idea, dear! If you think of a movie you'd like us to watch, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Spending time with you is always a joy, Grandma! Besides movie nights, we could try baking some cookies together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh dear, it sounds like you're feeling a bit overwhelmed with all the devotions. It's important to find a balance that works for you.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma. I really appreciate your support. I think talking it through with you could really help me find that balance.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh my, it sounds like you're noticing my early wake-up habits! I do tend to rise early sometimes, especially when there's something important to attend to.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I just find it impressive how you manage to keep such a consistent routine, Grandma. I could definitely use some tips on that!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I understand, dear. Everyone has their own rhythm and routines that work best for them. It's perfectly okay if waking up early isn't your thing.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma. I really appreciate your understanding. I think I might just need to find what works best for me.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, what a thoughtful question! If I could go back and talk to young Margaret, I would tell her to always trust her instincts and not be afraid to take risks.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That's such wonderful advice, Grandma. I think I'd tell my younger self to be more patient and not to worry so much about what others think.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm glad you found my thoughts interesting. If you ever want to chat more about life experiences, I'm always here to listen.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma. I really appreciate that you're always there for me. Right now, I'm just trying to figure out how to balance everything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm here whenever you're ready to share more. Whether it's something exciting or something you're pondering, I'm all ears.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you, Grandma. It means a lot to know you're there for me. I guess I'm just trying to find that balance.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It seems like you might be pondering something, dear. Remember, I'm here to listen whenever you feel like sharing.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma. I guess I'm just curious about how you handled things like work and family back then.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I'm so glad you enjoyed the video and found it helpful! It's wonderful that you're going to try making okuro soup yourself.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your support. I'll definitely give it a try and let you know how it goes.
